title: Project Settings
description: Project-level settings, including contact management options.

project_id.description: The unique ID of the project.

settings.description: The settings object containing contact settings.

ContactSettings.title: Contact Settings
ContactSettings.description: Settings related to contact management for the project.

unified_contact_id_enabled.description: Enables the Unified Contact ID feature. When enabled, contacts with the same phone number across SMS, RCS, and MMS channels are treated as a single entity. [See the documentation](https://developers.sinch.com/docs/conversation/unified-contact-id/) for details and requirements.
